login_background.description: Architectural minimalism in B&W. Use as a subtle background for the login page with an overlay.

dashboard_header.description: Modern interior abstract. Use for the Support page header or Settings background.

empty_state.description: Diagonal lines light/shadow. Use for empty states or 'No Scans Yet' screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a 'Swiss Brutalist' aesthetic: Thick borders, bold typography, high contrast.
The Scanner UI must be the 'Hero'. Make the camera view full-width/height where possible, or a large central square.
Hide PII (Name, Email, Phone) in the frontend. Display '***' or 'Hidden'.
Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications (Scan Success, Error, etc.).
Ensure the 'Scan' button is a massive Floating Action Button (FAB) or fixed bottom bar trigger.
Use 'lucide-react' for icons. Keep them stroke-width-2 for boldness.
Do NOT use gradients. Use solid black, white, and the accent green.
For the 'Loyalty Balance', use a large monospace font counter.
Mock the Boomerang API calls if the real API is not accessible, but structure the code to easily swap in the real endpoint.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' (generic rounded corners, soft shadows, blue primary). Go sharp and bold.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements (z-index).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures or noise overlays are encouraged.
